# Q3 Planning Meeting Summary — 2026-08-27

## Key Decisions

- **Reconciliation revamp** approved as Q3 anchor. Build over buy — vendor options (Recur at $180K/yr, LedgerFlow at $140K/yr) rejected; LedgerFlow can't handle jurisdiction-specific tax codes, and both would still require ~3 engineer-weeks of integration. In-house rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including FX rounding module migration.
- **Mobile receipt-capture v1** will ship without bulk-select to avoid descoping other work. Bulk-select moved to roadmap as a fast-follow. OCR confidence indicator to be made more prominent per user testing feedback.
- **Vendor payout SLA (48-hour target)** — decision deferred pending trade-off analysis next week. Proposed path: cut ACH batching window from 12h to 4h (eng), add a west-coast second approver (ops). Contingent on SRE sign-off for increased monitoring load.
- **Audit-log retention update** pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal).
- **Internal admin-tool refresh** stays with the intern crew — no changes.

## Action Items / Next Steps

- **Marcus:**
  - Sync with Karim's manager this week to confirm 2-week platform assist for ledger integration.
  - Draft rotating on-call proposal (addressing bug-bash burnout flagged by HR) by the 31st.
  - Pair with Jenna on ACH batching trade-off analysis for next week.
- **Dan:** Update mobile receipt-capture specs (drop bulk-select, strengthen OCR confidence indicator) by Wednesday.
- **Jenna:** Partner with Marcus on ACH trade-off analysis.
- **Priya:** Circulate Q3 scope draft Thursday morning; lock scope Friday.
- **Sara:** Take Q3 scope into exec review Monday.

## Open Items to Watch

- Karim's availability (blocker for reconciliation timeline).
- SRE sign-off on ACH monitoring overhead — if not manageable, fall back to intermediate SLA targets rather than 48h p95.
- Eng team capacity — Marcus flagged the team is already stretched by reconciliation work.
